answer: Sponsors are capped at 5 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 63 POA until the newcomer survives 16 clean epochs, and a farm of 340 fakes must find 340 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. Without beacon the panel is blind, without willow the farm is free, and without lantern nobody can prove what happened.
